title: Chromatic Energy Transfer Station
description: A shader energy conservation workstation where the PrimaryIonDrive generates chromatic energy that flows through custom shaders into the IridescenceAbalone and ShaderBall2. Users manipulate coupled shader parameters—hue shift, fresnel intensity, distortion amplitude, and iridescence spread—across all three objects while maintaining a total energy budget. Undo/redo lets users backtrack through their shader tuning history.
prompt:
Create a single HTML file using Three.js r170 (importmap from cdn.jsdelivr.net) implementing a Chromatic Energy Transfer Station. Load PrimaryIonDrive.glb centered-left, IridescenceAbalone.glb centered, and ShaderBall2.glb centered-right, spaced 3 units apart. Camera at (0,2,8) with OrbitControls. Use HDR-style lighting: one warm directional light, one cool fill light, and ambient light.

Apply custom ShaderMaterial to all three models by traversing their meshes. Each shader must support these uniforms: uHueShift (0-1), uFresnelPower (0.5-5), uDistortion (0-0.3), uIridescence (0-1), and uEnergyLevel (0-1). The vertex shader should displace vertices along normals by uDistortion scaled by a sine wave of position and time. The fragment shader should compute a fresnel rim glow, apply hue rotation to the base color, and blend an iridescent rainbow effect using the view angle.

Implement an ENERGY CONSERVATION LAW: total energy across all three objects is fixed at 1.5. When the user increases one object's energy slider, the other two decrease proportionally. Energy level scales the brightness, glow intensity, and distortion amplitude of each object's shader.

Create an HTML panel with: (1) three energy sliders (one per object) that are coupled via conservation, (2) global hue shift slider affecting all objects, (3) per-object fresnel power knobs (three sliders), (4) a global distortion amplitude slider, (5) a global iridescence intensity slider. That gives 9 interactive controls.

Implement full UNDO/REDO: store snapshots of all parameter states on every slider change. Keyboard shortcuts Ctrl+Z for undo, Ctrl+Shift+Z for redo, plus on-screen buttons. Display current step count and history depth.

Multi-input coupling: changing global iridescence also modulates each object's fresnel power inversely (higher iridescence reduces fresnel). Changing distortion on the IonDrive feeds 50% of its value into the Abalone's distortion. Animate uTime uniform for continuous vertex animation. Show energy values numerically beside each object using CSS labels positioned via world-to-screen projection.
